rules.intro: Changes that make your rules stricter apply now. Changes that loosen them wait until the next day (or until a running window ends), and you can cancel them until then.
rules.loadFailed: Could not load your rules. Reload the page.
rules.feedback.pending: Saved. What loosens takes effect {time}; anything stricter applies now.
rules.feedback.cancelled: Waiting change cancelled. Your current rules stay.
rules.rejected.schema: These rules are not valid, so nothing was saved. Check the times, days and minutes.
rules.rejected.duplicate_key: Two rules target the same thing, so nothing was saved.
rules.rejected.invalid_domain: That site address cannot have a rule, so nothing was saved.
rules.rejected.invalid_time_zone: The time zone is not known on this device, so nothing was saved.
rules.rejected.too_large: That file is too large for a rule set, so nothing was imported.
rules.rejected.invalid_json: That file is not a rule set, so nothing was imported.
rules.rejected.stale_revision: Your rules changed in another window. They were reloaded; make the change again.
rules.pending.title: Waiting until {time}
rules.pending.body: These changes loosen your rules, so they wait. Until then your current rules apply.
rules.modeHint.allow: Always reachable, even when a broader rule would stop it.
rules.modeHint.hide-feed: The site works; its endless feeds are hidden.
rules.modeHint.friction: A pause and an intention before each visit.
rules.modeHint.block: Not reachable while the rule applies.
rules.sites.title: Sites and feeds
rules.sites.domainHint: A domain such as example.com; it covers its subdomains.
rules.editor.label: Edit the rule for {target}
rules.editor.budgetHint: Leave empty for no budget; 1 to 1440 minutes.
rules.subreddits.title: Allowed Reddit communities
rules.subreddits.body: Communities you allow open without the pause and show on the hidden feed’s page.
rules.subreddits.name: r/{name}
rules.subreddits.hint: The name after r/, 2 to 21 letters, digits or underscores.
rules.bedtime.title: Bedtime
rules.bedtime.body: During bedtime, distracting sites are blocked. It starts on the days you pick and ends the next morning.
rules.workHours.title: Work hours
rules.workHours.body: Rules set to “Work hours” apply in this window.
rules.categories.title: Site levels
rules.categories.body: How each site counts in your Pulse, from Distracting to Focus. Your levels replace the built-in ones.
rules.categories.empty: You have not set any site levels; the built-in ones apply.
rules.transfer.title: Import and export
rules.transfer.body: Export your rules as a JSON file, or import one. An import that loosens anything waits like any other change.
preferences.storeTitles.description: Off by default. When on, page titles are kept on this device with your activity (never in private windows, never synced). Titles can reveal what you read.
preferences.audible: Count a playing tab while I am idle
preferences.audible.description: A lecture or a talk keeps counting when you do not touch the keyboard.
preferences.failed: Could not save the preference. Try again.
preferences.macApp.description: With the monki-focus Mac app installed, the extension shares the sites you visit (domain and path, never the query) with it on this device. The browser asks once for permission to talk to the app.
preferences.macApp.connected: Allowed: the extension talks to the Mac app while it runs.
preferences.macApp.denied: Not allowed. The extension keeps working on its own.
stats.failed: Could not load the statistics. Reload the page.
stats.empty: Nothing tracked in the last seven days yet.
stats.pulse.title: Pulse · 7 days

stats.heatmap.caption: Averaged over {weeks} weeks. Empty cells had no tracked time.
heatmap.summary: {title}; the table view lists every hour.
stats.intentions.title: Intentions
stats.data.title: Your data
stats.data.body: Everything stays on this device. Export it whenever you like, or delete it. Your rules and preferences are kept.
stats.data.confirmBody: Your tracked time and history before today are erased for good. Today stays, so your daily limits keep counting; your rules and preferences stay too.
stats.data.failed: That did not work. Try again.

about.privacy.title: Privacy in short
about.privacy.local: Your rules and activity stay on this device. Nothing is sent anywhere.
about.privacy.noUrls: Time is kept by site and path, never the full address, its query or a fragment.
about.privacy.titles: Page titles are not stored unless you turn that on.
about.privacy.export: You can export or delete your data at any time.
about.privacy.leave: You can always remove the extension from the browser.
rules.rejected.too_many_rules: Today this change would need more than 500 rules at once, so nothing was saved. Make it in smaller steps.
rules.rejected.invalid_ruleset: The rules that would apply today would not be valid, so nothing was saved.
rules.rejected.zone_change_pending: A time-zone change is already waiting until {time}, so nothing was saved. Keep that zone or the current one until then.
